responsibility: Implements the common pretty-printer for C-like syntax used by both C and C++ front ends. It converts GCC trees for expressions, declarations, types, and selected C-family statement nodes into human-readable source-like text, provides helper formatting primitives for tokens and qualifiers, and supplies print_c_tree/debug_c_tree facilities used in dumps, diagnostics, and selftests.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of the C-syntax pretty printer: it defines the printing helpers, c_pretty_printer methods, tree/statement rendering, and debug/selftest support, whereas c-pretty-print.h declares the c_pretty_printer class, flags, callback slots, and exported helper functions.
